worker_target_description: Relationship between webpage background complexity and attention to the commercial. Nonstudent adult replication. Supplied p. 39 Table 2 is about web experience, a different predictor. No outcome-specific complexity F/p is printed in the inspected findings or Appendix B.
worker_notes: Only assigned replication fields reviewed. Original and unassigned success fields are placeholders. No explicit target-test analytic N is printed. Page 37 reports 95 participants taking part; rendered Appendix B (p. 42) reports Study 2 Sample Size 92. Neither is explicitly assigned to this particular test, and exclusions/missingness are not explained. No N inferred from df. Both counts retained as sample candidates only. Supplied Table 2 tests web experience, not webpage complexity. Findings give only the joint five-outcome complexity MANOVA (F = .57, p = .84), not the described outcome-specific complexity test. No target-specific F/p is printed in the inspected findings or Appendix B; do not substitute another predictor or joint test. Known mismatch candidate in Table 2: web-experience effect on attention-to-the-commercial F = 2.458, p = .069.
